sources: Existing wave1/wave2 cast sources and their included high meshes; no inference or paid compute.
automation: skin-crowd-build.sh owns remeshing, binding, UV/atlas repair, eye and brim clearance, protected props, compression, validator and manifest/bake updates; no per-asset manual edits.
protectedDetails: BBQ spatula stays on handR and the apron decal stays on torso; original prop/decal UV pixels are reserved before gutter extension.
nativeHeads: Continuous native infected retain authored hair/caps/visors, using the same appearance-policy branch as aftermath bodies; explicit story accessories still win. Random replacement head pieces were rejected after front/back street review exposed stacking and floating fits.
headPalette: Explicit multi-swatch hair palettes repair back-of-head paint inside head UV islands, excluding the measured face. Generic single-swatch hair exports preserve their cap/visor paint. The red shape under the mother's hair was isolated as torso collar geometry and remains cloth.
farLod: Retain the sound middle-LOD anatomy at distance. All registered per-identity triangle limits remain unchanged; smaller atlas and recorded bind-frame position precision enforce the strict 150 kB far file cap.
compression: Position precision is measured in the existing bind frame, with collapsed triangle vertices restored, including UV duplicates. No scale node outside the skin.
fixture: Scene Lab installs the L1 Outbreak by default. L9 captures explicitly remove its dressing so actual native infected render; all 30 actors must be drawn and all seven native identities must have four bodies.
headRegions: The builder emits skin/authored vertex labels for native heads, never a blanket hair discard label. This preserves lower-face/beard geometry when an explicit accessory is worn; the default authored head appearance is unchanged.
